samuel1.9.p1.b1.text: Now there was a Benjamite, a powerful man, whose name was Kish …

samuel1.9.p1.b2.text: And he had a son named Saul, choice and handsome, without equal among the Israelites …

samuel1.9.p1.b3.text: … a head taller than any of the people.

samuel1.9.p2.b1.text: “Take one of the servants and go look for the donkeys.”

samuel1.9.p2.b2.text: So Saul passed through the hill country of Ephraim and then through the land of Shalishah, but did not find the donkeys. He and the servant went through the region of Shaalim … Then they went through the land of Benjamin, and still they did not find them.

samuel1.9.p3.b1.text: “Come, let us go back, or my father will stop worrying about the donkeys and start worrying about us.”

samuel1.9.p3.b2.text: “… in this city there is a man of God … Perhaps he will tell us which way to go.”

samuel1.9.p3.b3.text: “If we do go,” Saul replied, “what can we give the man? …

samuel1.9.p3.b4.text: “I have here in my hand a quarter shekel of silver. I will give it to the man of God …

samuel1.9.p4.b2.text: “Yes, he is ahead of you,” they answered. “Hurry now, for today he has come to the city because the people have a sacrifice on the high place.

samuel1.9.p4.b3.text: As soon as you enter the city, you will find him … Go up at once; you will find him.”

samuel1.9.p4.b4.text: So Saul and his servant went up toward the city, and as they were entering it, there was Samuel coming toward them on his way up to the high place.

samuel1.9.p5.b1.text: Now on the day before Saul’s arrival, the LORD had revealed to Samuel,

samuel1.9.p5.b2.text: “At this time tomorrow I will send you a man from the land of Benjamin, and you are to anoint him leader over My people Israel …

samuel1.9.p5.b3.text: “Here is the man of whom I spoke; he shall rule over My people.”

samuel1.9.p6.b1.text: “Would you please tell me where the seer’s house is?”

samuel1.9.p6.b3.text: As for the donkeys you lost three days ago … they have been found. And upon whom is all the desire of Israel, if not upon you and all your father’s house?”

samuel1.9.p6.b4.text: “Am I not a Benjamite from the smallest tribe of Israel … So why would you say such a thing to me?”

samuel1.9.p7.b1.text: Then Samuel took Saul and his servant, brought them into the hall, and seated them in the place of honor among those who were invited—about thirty in all.

samuel1.9.p7.b2.text: “Bring the portion I gave you and told you to set aside.”

samuel1.9.p7.b3.text: “Here is what was kept back. It was set apart for you. Eat, for it has been kept for you for this occasion, from the time I said, ‘I have invited the people.’”

samuel1.9.p7.b4.text: So Saul dined with Samuel that day.

samuel1.9.p8.b1.text: And after they had come down from the high place into the city, Samuel spoke with Saul on the roof of his house.

samuel1.9.p8.b2.text: “Get ready, and I will send you on your way!”

samuel1.9.p8.b3.text: “Tell the servant to go on ahead of us …

samuel1.9.p8.b4.text: … but you stay for a while, and I will reveal to you the word of God.”
